PS5 Payload SDK: v0.42
PacBrew: v0.40.2
Compiler: Clang 18.1.3
CMake: 3.28.3
Generator: Unix Makefiles
Build type: Release
Static library: ON
Position-independent code: ON
Git core.abbrev: 7

Configure using cmake-options.txt.

Additional required CMake arguments:
-DCMAKE_C_FLAGS=-I<PACBREW_PORTS>/include
-DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS=-L<PACBREW_PORTS>/lib

PACBREW_PORTS refers to the isolated PacBrew
user/homebrew directory.

The generated SDL_config.h must define:
HAVE_ICONV_H 1
HAVE_ICONV 1
SDL_USE_LIBICONV 1

Build target: SDL2-static
Result: libSDL2.a

Do not substitute an unmodified SDL2 library.
The PS5 cached framebuffer modifications are essential.
